STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether injustice had been caused to Mr. Senaka Maithri de Livera who was employed as Senior Manager (Food and Bevarages) ofthe Royal Colombo Golf Club situated at No. 223, Model Farm Road, Colombo 08, by the non - payment of the bonus paid to other employeesfrom 2008 and non - payment of the salary increase given to other employees from January 2009, and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
